name: IPTC Data Verification
description: Verifies IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) metadata fields for authenticity markers, digital source type classification, and AI tool signatures in professional photo workflows.
mechanism: Examines IPTC DigitalSourceType for non-photographic origin indicators, counts authenticity fields (credit, source, copyright, byline), and checks for synthetic/generated references.
parameters:
IPTC authenticity fields: credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords
DigitalSourceType: ISO 12639 classifications
accuracy: High - 85%+ for professional news/stock photos with IPTC data
